bug_semantics: When an application compiles attacker-controlled MJML with includes enabled—the vulnerable default before 5.0.0-alpha.9—the parser decodes the attacker-controlled mj-include path, resolves it with path.resolve(cwd, file), and passes the result to fs.readFileSync without proving that the resolved/real path remains beneath an allowed root. Absolute paths and ../ traversal therefore reach arbitrary readable filesystem objects. Ordinary MJML includes provide a file-existence/error oracle, disclose server paths and can consume problematic files; type="css" (and later type="html") reads the target as UTF-8 and places its contents directly into an output node, yielding direct file-content disclosure.
flaw_origin: The smallest root BIC is 584f60506757ba23436e7320d1c88061fb67d9cf in packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js: it first implemented mj-include by adding path/fs imports, resolving untrusted attrs.path relative to cwd, and immediately calling fs.readFileSync with no containment check. Later commits preserved or amplified that same flaw: b17d5585830822ecdc7bd6b3628249e3731e2750 introduced ignoreIncludes with an insecure false default; 30e29ed2cdaec8684d60a6d12ea07b611c765a12 exposed that false default through mjml2html as the incomplete CVE-2020-12827 mitigation; and bafb24a58bf11f778001a1535255e5b835e02a85 added the direct type="css" disclosure path. Those later commits did not precede the underlying unrestricted file-read mechanism and therefore are not the smallest BIC.
ai_marker: absent — the exact BIC commit object names author and committer as Maxime Brazeilles <maxime.brazeilles@gmail.com>, contains the subject "working include in xml parser", has one parent, and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI-attribution trailer.
evidence: Advisory and first-party issue: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-45h5-66jx-r2wf declares npm mjml < 5.0.0-alpha.9 affected and 5.0.0-alpha.9 patched; https://github.com/mjmlio/mjml/issues/3018 demonstrates both the ordinary-include existence oracle and type="css" reading /etc/passwd, and records the maintainer conclusion that includes should be disabled by default.

BIC diff: https://github.com/mjmlio/mjml/commit/584f60506757ba23436e7320d1c88061fb67d9cf shows packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js gaining handleInclude, path.resolve(cwd, file), fs.readFileSync(partialPath, 'utf8'), and the mj-include dispatch from decoded attrs.path. The numactl-prefixed `git log -L 122,132:packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js e3cc1230086bc199ff89a31d42a3c3d1bbf2d62f` trace reaches this commit as the first addition of those core vulnerable lines.

Direct-parent absence: `git grep -n -F fs.readFileSync 9ee155d5290fa2f9596e3fee535c0a12cc725d84 -- packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js` returned no match, and `git show 9ee155d5290fa2f9596e3fee535c0a12cc725d84:packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js` shows neither path/fs imports, handleInclude, mj-include dispatch, path resolution, nor a filesystem read. Parent tree: https://github.com/mjmlio/mjml/blob/9ee155d5290fa2f9596e3fee535c0a12cc725d84/packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js .

Impact-extension history: numactl-prefixed blame at fix parent e3cc1230086bc199ff89a31d42a3c3d1bbf2d62f attributes core handleInclude path resolution/read at lines 122-132 to 584f60506757ba23436e7320d1c88061fb67d9cf, the insecure parser default at line 37 to b17d5585830822ecdc7bd6b3628249e3731e2750, and the CSS resolution/read at lines 67-71 to bafb24a58bf11f778001a1535255e5b835e02a85. A separate `git log -L 67,71:packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js e3cc1230086bc199ff89a31d42a3c3d1bbf2d62f` confirms bafb24a58bf11f778001a1535255e5b835e02a85 first added the CSS-specific read.

Incomplete-fix lifecycle: https://github.com/mjmlio/mjml/commit/30e29ed2cdaec8684d60a6d12ea07b611c765a12 added `ignoreIncludes = false` to packages/mjml-core/src/index.js and forwarded it to the parser, so the CVE-2020-12827 control remained opt-in rather than securing default callers. The reporter and maintainers discuss that incomplete mitigation at https://github.com/mjmlio/mjml/issues/3018 .

Direct fix: https://github.com/mjmlio/mjml/commit/517b376b068e71c713ec4bb4ef9e5b0b7235b8ce changes ignoreIncludes defaults from false to true in packages/mjml-core/src/index.js and packages/mjml-parser-xml/src/index.js, adds isPathAllowed based on fs.realpathSync plus path.relative, and guards both handleCssHtmlInclude and handleInclude before fs.readFileSync. The fix PR is https://github.com/mjmlio/mjml/pull/3033 . Its merge commit 09f618c41f23350323a78191a7a2932889ba5d8a has 517b376b068e71c713ec4bb4ef9e5b0b7235b8ce as its second parent.

Version boundary: tag v5.0.0-alpha.8 peels to 6be02fcbcf3b55cbf4b31e3131741a432342ab62; historical grep finds ignoreIncludes=false in both core (line 140) and parser (line 37), unrestricted reads at parser lines 71 and 132, and no isPathAllowed. Tag v5.0.0-alpha.9 peels to a7434ec26bd19f0988d18fa26b2ba011afd2405d; grep finds ignoreIncludes=true at core line 423/parser line 37, isPathAllowed and guards at parser lines 67, 106 and 168, ahead of reads at lines 113 and 179. The release page https://github.com/mjmlio/mjml/releases/tag/v5.0.0-alpha.9 names #3018/#3033 as the security fix, and ancestry tracing places 517b376b068e71c713ec4bb4ef9e5b0b7235b8ce beneath that tag.

BIC/version membership: `git tag --contains 584f60506757ba23436e7320d1c88061fb67d9cf --sort=creatordate` begins with 4.0.0-alpha.3 and includes all observed 4.x and 5.0.0 alpha tags through the patched boundary; `git tag --contains 517b376b068e71c713ec4bb4ef9e5b0b7235b8ce` begins with v5.0.0-alpha.9 and excludes v5.0.0-alpha.8.

BIC-only AI check: numactl-prefixed `git cat-file commit 584f60506757ba23436e7320d1c88061fb67d9cf` returned tree 388c5a8185b1b83b03dc6e519e3ddbb330fc4ce8, sole parent 9ee155d5290fa2f9596e3fee535c0a12cc725d84, identical human author/committer Maxime Brazeilles <maxime.brazeilles@gmail.com>, the subject "working include in xml parser", and no trailers or bot/AI marker.
reasoning: The vulnerability is rooted in the parser's first implementation of mj-include, not in its later moves, refactors, mitigation attempt, or CSS extension. Line history identifies 584f60506757ba23436e7320d1c88061fb67d9cf as the commit that first connected decoded attacker path input to unrestricted path.resolve and fs.readFileSync; inspection of its immediate parent proves the entire include/file-read mechanism absent. The 2018 false default and 2020 false-default forwarding explain why CVE-2020-12827 was incompletely mitigated, while the 2021 CSS handler made full textual disclosure straightforward, but neither is earlier than the causal path-boundary omission. The advisory's vulnerable/patched boundary is corroborated in the actual v5.0.0-alpha.8 and v5.0.0-alpha.9 trees, and the advisory-linked direct patch is an ancestor of the patched release. Finally, the exact BIC commit object contains only a human author/committer identity and no AI signal, so BIC-only attribution requires NOT_AI.
